SPACE SHIELD | HUMANITY IN ORBIT

We are a team of innovators working to make human space exploration safer, smarter and healthier. At NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are exploring AI, 3D digital twins, and immersive technology to transform astronaut health monitoring. Our vision is to help space travelers understand changes in their physical and cognitive performance and make informed decisions during long missions, even far from Earth. Protecting explorers is essential to exploring farther.
